brewing.notes: A safe starting point for green tea: cooler water, short steeps, then adjust by taste.

description:
A clonal, early-sprouting, large-leaf shrub cultivar bred at the Wuxi tea variety institute in Jiangsu and listed as a national improved variety. It was selected from the Yixing local population.

Used for green tea.
history: Selection ran from 1974 to 1987, and it passed national approval in 1994 under number GS13005-1994. It grows in Wuxi, Yixing and Yizheng, with trial planting in Anhui, Hunan, Shandong and Henan. It is cold hardy and yields over 30 percent more per unit of area than Fuding Dabai.
processing: Typical of green tea: picked, heated soon after picking to stop oxidation, then shaped and dried.
harvest_season: Usually picked in spring, with the earliest pickings prized, as with most green teas.
appearance_dry: Green leaf whose shape depends on the maker, as is usual for regional green teas.
appearance_wet: Elliptical leaves on a medium-sized, half-spreading plant, with densely downy buds.
taste_profile: Expect what green teas usually give: fresh, vegetal and lightly sweet.
vintage_note: Green teas like this are normally sold as the current year's harvest and are best within a year of picking. It is not an ageing tea.
